plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Education Studies map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, 'Education Studies to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map (Terms 1-4) with no second-institution section; the pathway line says only 'to CSU' and names no continuation institution, degree, units or terms. The program's other pathway, 'Bakersfield College Education Studies Associate of Science' (printed at 60-61.5 units, 4 terms, to Degree), is a further pattern for the same AS credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-62.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. 'Major List A' is printed in Term 1 and again in Term 3, 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' in Term 2 and again in Term 3, and Term 4 prints three separate 'Major List C' rows at 3 units each; all are recorded as separate choice slots exactly as printed. No row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
